description: Python for .NET is a package that gives Python programmers nearly seamless integration with the .NET Common Language Runtime (CLR) and provides a powerful application scripting tool for .NET developers.

latest_release.name: v3.2.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Document MONO_THREADS_SUSPEND and use throughout CI by @filmor in https://github.com/pythonnet/pythonnet/pull/2747
* Fix shutdown regression with BinaryFormatter by @filmor in https://github.com/pythonnet/pythonnet/pull/2750
* Bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in the uv group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pythonnet/pythonnet/pull/2751


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pythonnet/pythonnet/compare/v3.2.0...v3.2.1
